commits.message: A pad drawn in another style than the base joins no run beside it, so no glyph is ever drawn in the pad's style (review of #580)
A right-to-left row placed at its own edge is padded unstyled, as the fill beside a Latin one is; tests pin a handed justify, a styled body and what a Padding hands a renderable (review of #580)
A text body in a Panel, Padding or Layout pane starts at its paragraph's edge, so a right-to-left one stands at the right inner edge (rich-control-codes-xh4n.9m6)

A pointer shape is parsed where it enters, so no caller writes a second OSC through OSC 22 (rich-control-codes-xh4n.19b) (#579)
